messages.text: Sorry for bothering you again but I haven't received any shipping info for order Shop····

You're not bothering me at all. You haven't had shipping info because nothing has shipped yet. Your Power K. is reserved at our warehouse, but the B30 is still waiting for stock to arrive there, so no label has been printed.

November 15 has now passed and I'm sorry about that. I'm not going to give you another date until it's confirmed. I've already passed your order to the team. They pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET and will email you the current date.

When it ships, tracking goes straight to this email. You can follow the batch here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
